reviewed_by: Claude: goal provider auto-retry, focused backend selection
reason: A running provider goal whose turn fails with a transient provider error (an overload or retryable status after the provider's own retries, a reply cut mid-stream, a torn or refused connection) now stays running once: Core marks the goal, notes the automatic retry in the failed turn's outcome note, and the idle-goal reconciler dispatches the continuation on a later pass. A second consecutive failure, non-transient errors, an operator pause and project holds pause or defer as before; a completed turn or an operator resume clears the mark. Providers type a cut stream (missing finish, torn transport after output) as ProviderStreamInterruptedError with error kind 'interrupted', keeping retryable=False and the same message. Selected: the new regression file plus the provider stream, robustness and leftover suites, goal lifecycle, turn outcome history, restart recovery, goal revision races, orphan recovery and hook turn-end suites that exercise the touched settle, reconcile and outcome paths.
exclusions: No UI, frontend or native change: the note reuses the existing turn-outcome message rendering, so frontend, native and Playwright layers are empty. Harness goal turns settle through a different path and are unchanged. No new operator setting, so the settings assistant catalog is unchanged. No full-suite approval.
